newsitem.title: USA: UMAX Data unveils high-end SuperMac PC.
newsitem.headline: UMAX Data unveils high-end SuperMac PC.

text.p: UMAX Data Systems Inc's UMAX Computer Corp Tuesday unveiled a high-end model in its SuperMac S900 family of personal computers compatible with Apple Computer Inc's Mac OS operating system.
The SuperMac S900/240 is based on a 240 MHz PowerPC 604e processor, and is priced at $5,795, with an estimated street price under $5000.
The first SuperMac S900/240 systems will ship in February, 1997, UMAX said.

"Our goal on the high end of our SuperMac product family is to bring systems to market that incorporate the highest performing PowerPC processors as soon as they become available," Andy Chang, senior vice president of worldwide sales for UMAX Computer Corp, said in a statement.
